{{Quote|And there are uncharted asteroids orbiting with the OboRins?''"<br />"''We're keeping an eye on them. We can take them out anytime.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Kenth Hamner]]|<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>}}
The '''OboRin Comet Cluster''', also known as the '''OboRins''', was a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] cluster on the edge of the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]].

==History==
{{Quote|Luke, the Yuuzhan Vong are already pushing through the comet cluster. Rather than fire through the refugee screen, Traest is falling back and trying to maneuver. Garm will have to join him soon or be cut off, and Wedge is two minutes behind schedule because the battle is moving toward Coruscant.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="SbS" />}}
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet|warfleet]] arrived in the OboRin Comet Cluster after their [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; First)|conquest]] of [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]]. This arrival marked the beginning of the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Fall of Coruscant]].
